packages/chord/src/next/store/engine.ts.reason: Pi's DocumentPoint (number | "current") is chord/next/store/engine.go#DocumentPoint, a struct whose zero value is "current" (AtSeq(n) is the number). The ledger's durable/types.go#DocumentPoint is the chord v1 session type of the same name, not the implementation of this Pi file.

packages/chord/src/watch.ts.reason: SingletonHandle declares no `value` or `watch` of its own: it extends Watchable<T> (watch.ts), so the ledger files these members under watch.ts. Their Go form is the Watchable interface of chord/watch.go (Value, Watch); chord/next/documents/handles.go's SingletonHandle declares the same two methods with the Go-forced difference that Value also returns an error (a read of a released handle refuses), and chord/next/documents/handles_test.go exercises them.
